inlines.v: EQUIP'MENT, noun The act of equipping, or fitting for a voyage or expedition. 1. Any thing that is used in equipping; furniture; habiliments; warlike apparatus; necessaries for an expedition, or for a voyage; as the equipments of a ship or an army.
